claims.text: Generative AI can produce diverse outputs including text, audio, images, video, and synthetic data.
LLMs use transformer models to detect relationships between sequence elements to provide context support.
Generative AI models can perform effectively in accuracy in specificity.
Generative AI models can perform effectively in user personalization.
Generative AI models can perform effectively in human-computer communication.
Generative AI models and LLMs can produce hallucinations, incorrect information, and unreliable results.

evidence.description: It can generate different outputs ranging from texts, audio, objects, pictures, and paintings to videos, but also synthetic data.
They use transformer models to detect how elements in sequences relate to each other. This provides context support.
Results from applying these models have shown that they can work well for accuracy in specificity...
Results from applying these models have shown that they can work well for ... user personalization ...
Results from applying these models have shown that they can work well for ... human-computer communication...
...they may not provide acceptable, reliable and truthful results. For example, ethics, hallucinations and incorrect information, or misjudgments, are some major problems.

limitations.text: LLMs and Gen AI models may fail to provide acceptable, reliable, and truthful results due to hallucinations, misjudgments, and ethical concerns.

future_work.text: Investigation of research questions and future directions regarding LLM deployment, limitations, and recommendations.
